ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Used_On__c, "EMD" )) && NOT(ISBLANK( CPN_Used_on_TKT_No__c )) && NOT(ISBLANK( Mileage_Equivalent__c ))
